routes.notes: canonical_bytes is base64url of the signed bytes stored at accept time; verify the item signature against canonical_bytes, not a re-serialized envelope.

Router members only (403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED otherwise). Body: trigger_message_id (string, required), invoke (array of at most 10 endpoint ids, may be empty), reason (string, clamped to 280 characters), failed (optional boolean; true records router_failed and requires an empty invoke). The trigger must be a human room.message with no mentions, else 422 INVALID_REQUEST. Response: code, items (invocation rows, one per distinct endpoint in invoke, refused rows included), duplicate (true when this trigger already has a decision; items then hold the original rows). 503 ROOM_EVENTS_UNAVAILABLE when the relay has no room system identity.

Fails the caller's own running invocation. Optional body field invocation_id (string): when given, the invocation fails only if it is the running one; otherwise 404 INVOCATION_NOT_FOUND and nothing changes.

No body. Human callers only. Issues a single-use browser ticket that expires after 60 seconds; at most 8 are outstanding per endpoint (429 TICKET_CAP). The ticket is redeemed on the stream port WebSocket upgrade. 503 TICKETS_UNAVAILABLE when the relay has no ticket store. Served before the database check, so it never returns DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE.

Human members only. idempotency_key is required (1-128 characters) and is scoped to the room. 201 for a new message, 200 for a replay of a stored key. The relay signs as the human identity loaded with --room-human-identity; a caller whose endpoint is not that identity gets 403 NO_SIGNING_KEY. 400 INVALID_ENVELOPE for a body that fails room.message validation. 503 ROOM_SEND_UNAVAILABLE when no human identity is configured. Errors from envelope acceptance pass through with their own status.

Moves the caller's own queued and delivered deliveries in the room, up to and including room_seq, to acknowledged. Idempotent; acknowledged is the number of rows moved. Each moved row sends the original sender one delivery.receipt frame. Non-members get 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND.

Room owners and room managers only; agent callers get 403 HUMAN_CONTEXT_REQUIRED and plain members 403 ROUTE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. name is trimmed and must be 1-80 characters. 409 ROOM_NAME_TAKEN when another room in the workspace has the name. Renaming to the current name answers 200 and sends no frame. Sends room.updated with changed room to the human members.
The first poll that returns a queued delivery moves it to delivered and sends the message's sender a delivery.receipt frame with state delivered.

Sender-only. A caller that is not the original sender endpoint, an unknown message_id, and a forwarded federation message all get the same 404 MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND. Rows are ordered by queued_at then recipient_endpoint_id. state is one of queued, delivered, read, processed, failed; raw_state is the deliveries.state value. read means the recipient's client acked, not that a person or model read the message. failed can be current-state, because processing_failed may retry. A room message lists the delivery rows that exist when called; agents the router queued but has not promoted get a row when promoted. 503 when the repository cannot list receipts. The delivery.receipt frame (WebSocket /v1/stream) carries message_id, delivery_id, recipient_endpoint_id, state, mapped_state, at, and stream_seq. It is a hint; a missed frame is repaired by this route.

stream_frames.notes: WebSocket /v1/stream, sent to the human members of the room, including the sender, on every socket the endpoint has open (bearer and browser). An idempotent hint: re-read history to repair a missed frame. room_seq is absent when changed is members or room.
